		name = omni_library_scrolls.buy.scroll_helluvian_poetry_10
		trigger = {
			NOT = { country = { has_variable = omni_scroll_read_helluvian_poetry_10 } }
			is_target_in_variable_list = { name = omni_library_scroll_stock target = flag:scroll_helluvian_poetry_10 }

		}
		custom_tooltip = omni_library_scrolls.scroll_helluvian_poetry_10.tooltip
